nodes.label: .`a lookup maps the full-job rows, machine and first-session choices`()
.`an active session makes the job collectable and carries the RAJ id as its cycle`()
.`capture is outboxed on the Rajoo family with the session id`()
.`finish ends the session and close marks the job closed`()
.`identify returns the source and pallet_not_found is Unknown`()
.`each decision is sent in the active session with the job revision and trimmed reason`()
.`substitute names the replaced row and the source, omit sends no target`()
.`a decision without a reason, session or positive total is refused before sending`()
.`a General snapshot has no Rajoo job`()
